description: READ EVERYTHING about a project in one call: description, ALL project-level comments, and the content of ALL files attached to the project, its comments, or linked in Markdown (same output format as read_issue). Does not include the issues of the project.

include_media.description: default true: also return the content of every file (images viewable, text inline, zip listings, others saved locally)

raw_files.description: default false: ALSO attach every PDF/Office/other binary file untouched as an embedded document (up to 20 MB each), for clients that read such files natively

name: read_project
